extraction_notes: Exact device identity is BC847B, an NPN transistor: the supplied PDF is titled BC847 and its BC847B classification range is 200-450 at IC = 2 mA and VCE = 5 V. The job manufacturer is Guangdong Hottech; the PDF header/footer brands the document Hottech Electronic and Shenzhen Hottech Electronics Co., Ltd.
Pages 1-4 were examined. Pages 1-2 contain the electrical table and typical-characteristics plots; pages 3-4 contain package and tape dimensions.

The retained curves are compact direct readings from visible grid positions in the p. 2 DC plots. Values are observations of plotted traces, not interpolated points. The plots are family/typical curves and are not converted into BC847B guaranteed limits.
The BC847B hFE classification is a guaranteed range: 200 minimum to 450 maximum at IC = 2 mA and VCE = 5 V. No typical hFE was inferred from that range.
VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) are guaranteed maximums at IC = 100 mA and IB = 5 mA; those maximum bounds were not converted into typical values.

Absolute maximum ratings include VCBO = 50 V, VCEO = 45 V, VEBO = 6 V, IC = 100 mA, PC = 200 mW, TJ = 150 degC, and TSTG = -55 to +150 degC at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise stated. Only VCEO is representable in this schema.

The p. 2 capacitance plot contains both Cob and Cib traces, but no scalar Cib table value is provided; cibo remains null. The scalar Cob table value is retained. The fT plot and capacitance plot are omitted from curves because this extraction keeps compact DC evidence; their tabulated scalar fields remain transcribed.
No Early-voltage scalar was extracted: the static-characteristic plot is a fixed-base-current output family, not a published VAF value. No temperature-coefficient table data were provided.
omission_reason: No scalar Cib value or Early-voltage value is published. DC curve observations are retained; non-DC fT and capacitance plots are not included as curves, while available scalar fT and Cob table fields are transcribed.
